name: Symbiotic Monster (CR +1)
body:
A “Symbiotic monster” is a creature which has been bound to a primal urge. When such creatures are weak willed or unthinking they become a monster constantly fulfilling the need of the primal urge they have bonded with. This changes the monster’s tactics, and the primal urge usually bestows 1 or more morphs onto the creature in question.

Creating a Symbiotic Monster
Challenge Rating: Same as the base creature +1.
Hit Dice: Change all racial Hit Dice to d10s.
Natural Armor: The symbiotic monster gains it’s Charisma modifier in natural armor (min 1)
Quirk: The symbiote gains a personality quirk from the list of primal urge personality quirks, the monster behaves mostly in the method that the personality quirk defines in combat. Special Attacks: The symbiotic monster retains all the base creature’s special attacks and gains those described here.
Morph: The symbiotic creature gains 1 morph, usually utility or offensive morphs. But this morph may be any non-master morph that adjusts the creature to its environment and extends some advantage to fulfilling the desire of the primal urge attached to it.
Symbiote Breed: The symbiotic monster gains the 1st level symbiote breed ability from it’s breed type. If the monster has 5 or more hit dice it also gains the 3rd level breed ability. If the creature has levels in primal host add them to this 3rd level for the purposes of determining the symbiote breed abilities. Abilities: Constitution +4; Charisma +2 (minimum 12). Any creature bound with a primal urge has a minimum Charisma of 12 for the purposes of determining the save DC’s of morphs. Environment: Same as the base creature, plus any environment its morph allows it to exist in.
